spec.name: Merja Wlad Skher Lake
spec.description: A freshwater lake and bird sanctuary on the Rmel Plateau. It is an internationally recognized wetland (Ramsar site) that supports rare species like the Marsh Owl and serves as a key stopover for birds on the East Atlantic Flyway.

timeline.title: Battle of the Three Kings
timeline.description: The surrounding marshes played a strategic role in the defeat of the Portuguese army due to the difficult terrain.

timeline.title: Ramsar Inclusion
timeline.description: The lake was included in the 'Marais et côte du Plateau de Rmel' Ramsar site.
